purpose: Freeze the exact project-matched full-reference SCANVI recipe for jackknife. Do not redesign for performance.

shared_preprocess.hvg_selected_on: reference cells only (then query intersected to reference genes)
shared_preprocess.query_procedure: load model; subset to model genes; SCANVI.predict / soft probabilities

PanGI.counts_source: .raw.X integer counts (X is normalized; do not train on X)
PanGI.model_class: direct SCANVI from scratch (no scVI pretraining)
PanGI.seed_policy_jackknife: integer seeds 0..9 for full; 0..2 minimum for representative jackknives
PanGI.train_size_note: scvi-tools default when not passed to model.train (manifest documents default ~0.9); do not invent a new value
PanGI.jackknife_change_allowed: omit one study from reference cells only

HGCA.model_class: SCANVI with scVI pretrain as executed in 04_train_full_models.ipynb
HGCA.seed_policy_jackknife: integer seeds 0..9 for full; 0..2 minimum for representative jackknives; record actual seed used
HGCA.jackknife_change_allowed: omit one dataset_id from reference cells only

unavoidable_implementation_differences.PanGI: direct SCANVI; train_pangi_full_reference.py explicitly disables pretraining
unavoidable_implementation_differences.action: Do not redesign. Keep each atlas on its project-matched recipe. Document in all comparative claims.
Jackknife uses explicit multi-seed schedules; do not hide seed under a single default.
Native columns retained; no forced renaming of biology.
Normalize hierarchical depths; do not compare raw entropy across atlases without calibration.

forbidden_changes: Do not switch to frozen-latent LODO recipe (pangi_stroma.yaml n_epochs=0)
Do not change HVG count, epochs, latent dim, or likelihood to chase performance
